name: Macher
description: A priest in a Gavony church, raised by the church, whose doubts about Avacyn are answered by a terrifying visit from her.

timeline.summary: Macher, troubled by doubts about whether Avacyn is worthy of worship, prays for her to exist.
timeline.quote: Avacyn, please exist. Please be true.

timeline.summary: Avacyn descends into the church courtyard before Macher.
timeline.quote: Macher whirled, his mouth agape, and saw an angel descend.

timeline.summary: Avacyn accuses Macher of doubting, mocks his claim to be pure, and asks whether she has lost faith in him.
timeline.quote: You prayed to me because you doubted.

timeline.summary: Terrified, Macher collapses; Avacyn whispers 'Soon' and vanishes, leaving him certain of the true nature of his god.
timeline.quote: He lay there huddled through the night, cloaked in terrifying certainty about the nature of his god.

relations.note: Raised by the church from toddlerhood and a priest.
relations.quote: He had been fed by the church and clothed by the church and protected by the church

relations.note: Macher knew Mikaeus, the former lunarch, and saw him as a zombie.
relations.quote: Macher had known Mikaeus, the former lunarch

pages_say.description: A priest in a Gavony church, raised by the church, whose doubts about Avacyn are answered by a terrifying visit from her.
